name: Dorei Goumon Show II
source:
As a sl*ve trader, your first order of business with new "products" is to properly discipline them.
And it seems another 3 cheeky sl*ves have joined the ranks, ready for training.
You're newly hired female t*rturer doesn't seem completely devoted to you, but she'll soon come to realize that those who do not dance to your tune meet tragic ends.
